summary:
Held 1 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — IMB.L +15%, STLAP.PA +9%, EDV.L +7%, FRES.L +6%, BAYN.DE +6%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 3 downside moves (LAND.L -1%, SVT.L -1%, IHG.L -1%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: IMB.L (+14.56%) — Imperial Brands surged on takeover interest: Altria confirmed it is considering a possible all-cash offer after reports Japan Tobacco was studying a bid. Sources date the spike to Thu 26 Nov, a day before the bot's 27 Nov window. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: IMB.L is a FTSE 100 large-cap consumer staple (tobacco) that no strategy includes. The move was also an overnight M&A gap, so a post-close signal would be too late. The ~14.6% gap likely breaches gap/RSI filters as well.

top_movers.suggestion: Add FTSE 100 / STOXX 600 large caps to the news-reactive strategy's universe with an M&A gate: when a bid-interest headline arrives with a gap ≥ +8%, enter a small position capped at 0.5x normal size, since the price is then bounded by the possible offer.
